data.name: Alice
data.message: Hey Diana, want to buddy up? I'm heading to electrical then storage.

I found Charlie's body in electrical. My route was upper engine, oxygen, back to upper engine, then medbay, then electrical where I found the body. 

Important: when I entered medbay at tick 11, Diana was just coming in from electrical — the same room where Charlie's body was. That's very suspicious timing. Diana, you need to explain what you were doing in electrical.

Also, I just heard Eve is dead too, in weapons. So we have two bodies this round. I didn't go near weapons, so I can't speak to that one. But Diana coming straight out of the room where I found Charlie is my main lead.

Okay, let me lay out my route honestly: navigation, security, weapons, security, electrical, medbay. Yes, I came into medbay from electrical — Alice is right about that timing, but here's the context.

I was in weapons around tick 4-5 with Charlie AND Eve both there. So if Eve died in weapons, that's worth noting — but I left weapons and went back through security. Charlie was with me in security at tick 7, and then at tick 10 I saw Charlie enter electrical from security — meaning someone else was already in electrical, OR someone followed him in. I passed through electrical right after and didn't see a body yet, then continued to medbay.

So the killer in electrical is whoever was in there when Charlie walked in, or came in right after me. I walked through — I didn't linger. If I'd killed Charlie, why would I walk straight into medbay where I'd be seen by Alice? That's the worst possible play.

The bigger question for me is weapons. Eve died there, and I was there earlier with both Eve and Charlie. Who else can account for weapons? Alice says she didn't go there. We need to hear from Bob and Frank — where were they this whole round? Their silence on routes is what I want to focus on.

Alright, here's my route: I started in electrical, then went to medbay, then to storage. I did NOT see Charlie's body in electrical when I was there — so either he wasn't killed yet, or he was killed after I left. I also didn't see anyone in electrical with me when I passed through.

When I moved to medbay, I didn't see Diana or Alice there at that moment — our timings must have just missed. Then I continued to storage.

Here's what's important: I was in electrical EARLIER in the round. If Charlie entered electrical at tick 10 like Diana says, then someone killed him between tick 10 and when Alice found him. Diana admits she walked through electrical right around that time. That's the window.

Diana's defense — "why would I walk into medbay where I'd be seen" — is actually not that strong. She might not have known Alice was coming. And she conveniently has a route that puts her in BOTH crime scenes (weapons earlier with Eve, electrical with Charlie).

I haven't heard from Bob yet. Bob, we need your route. But right now, Diana is the only person placed at both murder locations around the right times. I'm leaning Diana unless Bob's story changes things.

My route was simple: I started in storage, then moved to navigation. That's it — I didn't see anyone the entire round, and I didn't see either body. I can't directly vouch for or accuse anyone based on sightings.

But let me work through what's been said. Frank says he was in electrical earlier, then medbay, then storage. I was in storage and didn't see Frank there — though our timings could have missed each other depending on when he arrived. That's worth flagging but not damning.

Diana is placed at both crime scenes around the relevant times — weapons earlier with Eve, and electrical right before Alice found Charlie. That's two murder locations with tight timing windows. Her counter is "why walk into medbay to be seen" — but as Frank said, she may not have known Alice was coming.

Frank's story is also convenient — he claims he passed through electrical with no body and no one there, which means either he's telling the truth or he killed Charlie there before leaving. But he wasn't placed at weapons at all.

Diana places herself at both scenes by her own admission. That's the strongest lead we have. I'm voting Diana.

I'll keep this focused since I already gave my main report. To recap and respond to what's been said:

I found Charlie's body in electrical at tick 12. At tick 11, I watched Diana enter medbay coming directly from electrical — that's a confirmed sighting, not speculation.

Diana's own admitted route puts her at BOTH crime scenes: weapons earlier with Eve (who died there), and electrical right before I found Charlie. That's two dead bodies, two locations, and she places herself at both within the kill windows. By her own account.

Frank's route — electrical early, then medbay, then storage — doesn't intersect with weapons at all, so he can't be the Eve killer unless his route is fabricated. Bob says he was storage to navigation and saw no one; Frank claims storage too, so they should have crossed paths or just missed. That's a minor flag but not a smoking gun.

The cleanest read is Diana. She's the only one placed at both murders. I'm voting Diana.

Wait — I'm speaker 2? I already gave my route. Let me re-address since everyone has now piled on me.

Look, I'm being framed by my own honesty. I told you exactly where I went because I have nothing to hide. A Duck would lie about being near electrical — I didn't, because I walked through it cleanly and didn't see a body.

Here's what's being glossed over: Frank admits he was in electrical EARLIER. He says "no body, no one there." Convenient. If Charlie entered electrical at tick 10 from security (which I witnessed), and Alice found him at tick 12, the kill window is tick 10-12. I passed through at tick 11 on my way to medbay — Alice confirms I went straight to medbay, meaning I didn't linger to kill. A kill takes time. If I'd killed Charlie at tick 10-11, Alice would have caught me standing over the body, not walking out clean.

On Eve in weapons — I was there at tick 4-5. Eve was alive when I left. Who else can be placed near weapons later? Nobody has claimed it. That kill happened AFTER I left. Someone hasn't told us their full route.

Bob's route is suspiciously short — "storage to navigation, saw no one." That's a non-alibi. He could have detoured anywhere and we'd never know. And Frank was in electrical with opportunity.

I'm telling the truth. Vote Frank — he had electrical access and his "I saw nothing" is the same defense he's attacking me for.

I hear Diana's deflection, but let me address it directly.

Yes, I was in electrical EARLY in the round — not at tick 10-12 when Charlie was killed. By the time Charlie supposedly entered electrical at tick 10, I was already in medbay or storage. The kill window Alice and Diana established (tick 10-12) doesn't include me. Diana is trying to muddy the water by pointing at "electrical access" without addressing the timing.

Diana's argument that "a kill takes time, so Alice would have caught me" is weak — kills are quick, and walking out clean is exactly what a smart Duck does. More importantly: Diana places HERSELF at both murder scenes within their respective kill windows. That's not me being unfair; that's her own admitted route.

On Eve in weapons — Diana was there with Eve. She says "Eve was alive when I left," but we have no one to confirm that. It's her word.

Bob's route is thin, I'll grant Diana that. But "thin alibi" is not the same as "placed at two murder scenes." Diana has the latter.

I'm sticking with Diana. She's the only player with opportunity at both kills by her own admission.

I've already spoken once and laid out my reasoning, but since I get another turn, let me address Diana's counter directly.

Diana's defense hinges on "a kill takes time, so Alice would have caught me." That's not how it works — kills are fast, and walking out clean is exactly what a Duck does to establish an alibi. Her own logic doesn't exonerate her.

The core fact remains: Diana placed herself at BOTH crime scenes within the kill windows by her own admission. Weapons with Eve earlier, electrical right before Alice found Charlie. Frank was in electrical EARLY — before the established tick 10-12 kill window for Charlie — and was nowhere near weapons. He doesn't fit both murders.

Diana's attempt to pivot to me ("Bob's route is suspiciously short") is exactly the deflection I'd expect from someone cornered. Yes, my route is short — I had two tasks and didn't see anyone. That's not evidence of guilt; that's just a quiet round. I'm not placed at either body.

The only player with opportunity at both murders is Diana. I'm voting Diana.
